annotation.title_clean: Council conclusions on support for influencers as online content creators (C/2024/3807)
annotation.title_en: Council conclusions on support for influencers as online content creators (C/2024/3807)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C series
named_instruments_referenced: Regulation on transparency and targeting of political advertising
UN Convention on the Rights of the Child
annotation.summary_en: EU Council conclusions on influencers as online content creators. They invite Member States and the Commission to support influencers' media literacy, responsible behaviour, self-regulation and compliance with EU law (AVMSD, DSA, UCPD, AI Act labelling of deepfakes), and to protect kidfluencers. AI is mentioned only in passing. Robotics is not covered.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States should make applicable rules accessible to influencers and support training and awareness campaigns
Commission to foster pan-European self-regulatory mechanisms, possibly an ethical code for influencers
Keep the Influencer Legal Hub up to date
Reflect on kidfluencers' wellbeing under the BIK+ strategy
Consider effects of influencers' AI use and AI Act labelling requirements
